title: PowerShell Sandbox Telemetry Pipeline

creators.name: Yaghoubi Avini, Farhad
creators.affiliation: Westfaelische Hochschule, Institute for Internet Security (if(is)), Gelsenkirchen, Germany

description: Collection pipeline that executes PowerShell scripts in a controlled Windows virtual machine and links per-sample static script information with Sysmon-based runtime telemetry, producing the training data used by the Fileless PowerShell Malware Detector. Developed for the master's thesis 'Runtime-Based Detection of PowerShell-Based Fileless Malware Using Deep Learning: A Systematic Architecture Comparison'.
